name: North American Financial 15 Split Corp.
summary: North American Financial 15 Split Corp. is an equity-focused mutual fund established by Quadravest Inc. and actively managed by Quadravest Capital Management Inc., investing in a portfolio of preferred and Class A shares from fifteen prominent financial services companies. Originally known as Financial 15 Split Corp. II, this Canadian-domiciled entity was formally established on October 15, 2004.
